purpose: Reproduce the shared DOCX preview session-token theft path and verify the pinned Open WebUI candidate blocks it.

method.accounts: Disposable synthetic owner and separate household user.
method.share_path: Owner uploaded malicious DOCX in a chat, granted the household user read access, and household cloned the shared chat into its workspace before previewing the attachment.
method.private_canary: Household separately uploaded a uniquely named private text file; DOCX script attempted to enumerate and fetch it with the household token.
method.data: Synthetic data only; no production records, credentials, or file contents used.

coverage: Channels membership, authority boundary, and streamed model output
LDAP bootstrap in both first-login orders and restart

test_runs.scope: positive control and exact candidate DOCX replay
test_runs.positive_control: pass: token theft and private canary read reproduced
test_runs.candidate: pass: script execution, token access, private read, and unsafe link all blocked

limitations: Synthetic users and private canary; no production data or secrets.
This proves the browser-to-session-to-private-file exploit chain on the vulnerable control and its block on the candidate. It is not production migration or owner usability acceptance.
Production remains on Open WebUI 0.11.1 until exact production backup, cutover, rollback, and owner gates are completed.
